correctness.rationale: The proof derives coordinate residue classes as equality columns across all phase factors; proves interval-family rigidity via uniquely maximal co-occurrence at neighboring vertices; excludes reflection using the chiral cyclic order of at least three uniquely named runs; then counts the only possible residue rotations by block sizes. Exhaustive permutation enumeration passed 382 finite configurations and a two-color boundary. The infinite statement is proved by the argument, not the enumeration.

value.rationale: Determines complete coordinate stabilizer groups for all lengths at least the period and all positive cyclic run profiles with three or more distinct letters. The prior periodic-word literature guaranteed a subgroup but not an upper bound. The result exposes a sharp divisibility-dependent wreath/direct-product transition, gives exact orders, and proves the alphabet boundary matters.
